title: KNOWING OURSELVES THROUGH OTHERS: REFLECTING WITH AI IN DIGITAL HUMAN DEBATES
reasoning: The research focuses on proposing 'Reflecting with AI' as a new generative AI literacy competency. While the debate topics used in the study included ethical issues such as euthanasia, the paper's primary focus is on the metacognitive process and self-reflection of participants rather than evaluating or benchmarking ethical, moral, or religious frameworks of the LLMs themselves.
